title: GSTR-9 (GST annual return)
question: What is GSTR-9, and what if it is missed?

body.normal: GSTR-9 is the yearly GST return. It brings together everything reported in the monthly or quarterly returns for the financial year.
body.simple: The once-a-year GST return that sums up the whole year.
body.detail: GSTR-9 sets the year's sales, tax paid and input tax credit side by side with what was reported during the year. Differences found here may need extra tax paid. Businesses below a turnover limit may not have to file it.
body.why: It is the last chance to correct the year's GST picture before the department reviews it.

facts.v: Yearly GST return summarising the financial year
Your firm prepares and files it; you approve the figures
A late fee for each day of delay, up to a limit linked to turnover.
